title: asn2wrs: Add recursion checks
description:
Add a simple recursion depth check whenever we have cyclic dependencies.

Fixes #19501

notes.body: assigned to @geraldcombs

Doing it only in the top frame of the cycle is a clever efficiency gain I didn't think of. Probably most of the cycles are relatively short but I don't know if that's guaranteed, so we might want to increment and decrement our depth counter by the length of the cycle (and increase `MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH` to 100 or something) so we don't get bit by a 50-frame cycle or something.

minor, but this can be `const`

changed this line in [version 6 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/13845/diffs?diff_id=883454493&start_sha=47114d49a0765e9ce6b1bdf9f7181a6edfc1381e#a63d25e11537b5d8dc0b338544f393ecaaf72a63_1564_1563)

I briefly managed to convince myself this was broken, because `pinfo->layers` is not unwound on the way back up the dissector call stack. But in the actual generated C code we're still in the same method and we can reuse the `proto_id` we got on our way down, so it should be fine. If we had to refetch the `proto_id` here it wouldn't work though.

Long run, should these perhaps mark the packet as Malformed but not indicate a Dissector bug? (As done with VLAN, other places with proto depth?) These can be triggered by fuzzed data but the dissector is working about as well as can be expected - some ASN.1 specs just allow cycles but it shouldn't be possible to have an infinite loop given our BER/PER/OER dissectors, these are stack exhaustion.

Maybe a new Exception type?

@@ -1550,6 +1550,23 @@ class EthCtx:
         if self.conform.check_item('PDU', tname):
             out += self.output_proto_root()
 
+        cycle_size = 0
+        if self.eth_dep_cycle:
+            for cur_cycle in self.eth_dep_cycle:
+                t = self.type[cur_cycle[0]]['ethname']
+                if t == tname:
+                    cycle_size = len(cur_cycle)
+                    break
+
+        if cycle_size > 0:
+            out += f'''\
+  const int proto_id = GPOINTER_TO_INT(wmem_list_frame_data(wmem_list_tail(actx->pinfo->layers)));
+  const unsigned cycle_size = {cycle_size};
+  unsigned recursion_depth = p_get_proto_depth(actx->pinfo, proto_id);
+  DISSECTOR_ASSERT(recursion_depth <= MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH);
+  p_set_proto_depth(actx->pinfo, proto_id, recursion_depth + cycle_size);
+'''
+
         if self.conform.get_fn_presence(self.eth_type[tname]['ref'][0]):
             out += self.conform.get_fn_text(self.eth_type[tname]['ref'][0], 'FN_HDR')
         return out
